contact_contract.domain_per_neighbor: Let S0 be the frozen selected solid and N_i each frozen neighbor. O_i is the intersection of actual triangle projections. J_i=projection_XZ(interior(S0 intersect N_i)) is the old genuine positive-volume contact footprint, not the entire O_i and not its sampled components.
contact_contract.pass: For every q in J_i, the new single occupied interval [B(q),T(q)] must overlap at least one actual parity/winding interval of N_i with positive length in the interior; boundary closures may touch at zero length. Thus no new positive-area separating gap can appear in an old joined footprint. At least one positive-volume component per cardinal neighbor, and the connected new bank plus four neighbors form a connected union. No requirement to retain old seam-loop counts, exact intersection curves or old overlap depth.
contact_contract.gap_metric: At q, enumerate all true N_i intervals [l_j,u_j]. signed_gap(q)=min_j(max(B(q),l_j)-min(T(q),u_j)); positive means separation, zero touch, negative volume overlap. Never use global minY/maxY if N_i has multiple intervals.
contact_contract.continuity_and_components: Build the full contact-volume cell adjacency and record each component and its incident neighbor. There must be no lost J_i region or newly disconnected selected component. Four positive sample rays do not establish this graph or continuum condition.
contact_contract.finite_verification_algorithm: Overlay projected edges of S0, N_i and candidate, plus Y-order/equality lines within each planar cell. Evaluate oriented crossing order to obtain all intervals. On resulting convex cells interval endpoint heights are affine: split at competing max/min branches, compute signed-gap extrema from vertices/edge limits, classify interior signs, and assemble contact-volume adjacency across cell faces. Include degenerate/vertical triangles and coplanar/tangent cases with exact or adaptive fallback; unresolved cells remain unproved. Also check actual triangle-triangle contacts and full source/native topology. This finite algorithm is specified for the next implementation; it is not implemented or passed by the local witness script.
